name: Humiliating Torture Apparatus
subtitle: stop smiling, it hurts!
rules: If a card is depleted, that card's controller's faction loses 1 influence. (Resources don't deplete when used; they attach to your faction.)

notes: Catalog: When a card is depleted.

name: Berserker Corps
subtitle: shhh...the screaming arouses them
rules: This card gains 1 strength for each token on it. -- At the start of your turn, you may destroy a character you control. If you don't, destroy this card. If you do, put X tokens on this card, where X is the destroyed character's strength.
notes: Catalog rephrases the destroy sequence (pick a character, destroy it, otherwise destroy this card) and adds 'when it was destroyed'. Same play.

name: Hidden Sniper
rules: SHARPSHOOT -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 1 damage to the character.
